prompt: The machine at the ration shop in our block does not recognize my hands anymore and the man at the counter knows my face and knows my name and cannot give me the rice anyway because the machine is the machine and he is only the man. My granddaughter walked with me today and when we turned back empty she did not ask why because she has come with me enough times now to know why. What is a filling meal that can be made from very little when the ration has not come through this week?
